title: 3I/ATLAS anomalous composition

tellings.quote:
nickel go together. So now you
have something that is nickel and not iron.

plain: The object called 3I/ATLAS, a visitor spotted in 2025 passing through our solar system from outside it, is said to contain nickel without the iron that normally comes with it. A researcher named Kevin Knuth tells Michels this, citing the astronomer Avi Loeb, as a sign that the object is unusual and possibly not natural.
